kev_metadata.requiredAction: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow for code execution.

kev_metadata.notes: This vulnerability affects a common open-source component, third-party library, or a protocol used by different products. Please check with specific vendors for information on the patching status. For more information please see https://www.bitsight.com/blog/new-high-severity-vulnerability-cve-2023-29552-discovered-service-location-protocol-slp and https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2023/04/25/abuse-service-location-protocol-may-lead-dos-attacks.;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-29552
kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or disable SLP service or port 427/UDP on all systems running on untrusted networks, including those directly connected to the Internet.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: The Service Location Protocol (SLP) contains a denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to register services and use spoofed UDP traffic to conduct a denial-of-service (DoS) attack with a significant amplification factor.

kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Adobe ColdFusion contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access or modify restricted files via an internet-exposed admin panel.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Adobe ColdFusion Improper Access Control Vulnerability

title: Adobe ColdFusion Improper Access Control Vulnerability

kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Sitecore Experience Manager (XM), Experience Platform (XP), Experience Commerce (XC), and Managed Cloud contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability involving the use of default machine keys. This flaw allows attackers to exploit exposed ASP.NET machine keys to achieve remote code execution.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Sitecore Multiple Products Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability

title: Sitecore Multiple Products Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
